close_reason: Test-only code; (&'static str, String) keys are correct. Two-level HashMap refactor has no API impact.
description: tests/common/mod.rs Inner struct uses HashMap<(&'static str, String), …> as the key for objects, states, and change_log. Every read path calls account_id.to_owned() or account_id.to_string() just to construct the lookup key, forcing a heap allocation for every get. The standard idiom is to use a Borrow-based lookup (e.g. .get(&(type_name, account_id.as_ref()) as a reference to a (&&str, &str) tuple)) or to store Arc<str> so the lookup clone is cheap. As-is, every backend call in every test allocates a fresh String for the account_id portion of the key.
title: Inner HashMap key uses String alloc on every lookup
